items.claim: Steve Erceg earned his title shot by beating Matt Schnell.
items.quote: He earned his title shot by beating Matt freaking Schnell, the most beatable guy in the UFC.

items.claim: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added striking, and possesses high fight IQ.
items.quote: I think Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added some striking, and I think he's high IQ.

items.claim: Steve Erceg has been getting by on favorable matchups and his fight IQ.
items.quote: I think he's getting by with A, favorable matchups, and B, his fight IQ.

items.claim: Steve Erceg has been knocked out by Kai Kara-France.
items.quote: We watched him get knocked out by Kai Kara-France.

items.claim: Steve Erceg cannot defend takedowns effectively.
items.quote: He just can't defend a freaking takedown.
